    ({"cpu": 4, "ram": 2}, [{"cpu": 4, "ram": 1}], True),

    ({"cpu": 1.5}, [{"cpu": 1.25}], True),
    ({"cpu": 4}, [], True),

    ({}, [], False),
    ({}, [{}], False),

]

    assert requests == original_requests

invalid_cases = [
    ([], [], TypeError),

    ({"cpu": 1}, [1], TypeError),

    ({"cpu": 1}, [{"cpu": "one"}], TypeError),
